scenes.title: The fiber confines and guides light

vo.text: A fiber-optic cable carries internet data as flashes of light inside a strand of glass.
vo.speak: A fiber-optic cable carries internet data as flashes of light inside a strand of glass.

vo.text: Instead of sending electrical pulses through copper, it guides light from one end to the other.
vo.speak: Instead of sending electrical pulses through copper, it guides light from one end to the other.

vo.text: At the cable's transmitter, a laser or LED turns digital data into rapid pulses of light.
vo.speak: At the cable's transmitter, a laser or LED turns digital data into rapid pulses of light.

vo.text: Those pulses enter the cable's narrow core, the central path reserved for the light.
vo.speak: Those pulses enter the cable's narrow core, the central path reserved for the light.

vo.text: The core is wrapped in cladding, which lets light reflect at the boundary instead of escaping.
vo.speak: The core is wrapped in cladding, which lets light reflect at the boundary instead of escaping.

vo.text: Each pulse follows the fiber by repeated total internal reflection, even when the cable bends.
vo.speak: Each pulse follows the fiber by repeated total internal reflection, even when the cable bends.

vo.text: At the destination, a photodetector senses the arriving pattern of light and darkness.
vo.speak: At the destination, a photodetector senses the arriving pattern of light and darkness.

vo.text: The receiver converts that pattern back into electrical data for your computer or router.
vo.speak: The receiver converts that pattern back into electrical data for your computer or router.

vo.text: So fiber-optic internet moves information by guiding coded light through glass, then decoding it at the far end.
vo.speak: So fiber-optic internet moves information by guiding coded light through glass, then decoding it at the far end.
